\*Note increased bleeding risk is a potential side effect of all\*

|                        | - ↓TXA~2~ production in platelet                                                    | - E: 20% (kidney)                                                   |

+------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+

|                        | - MoA: potentiate PGI~2~                                                            | - E: bile                                                           |
|                        | - SEs: bleeding headache, hypotension                                               | - D: t~1/2~~β~ 10 hours → BD dose                                   |

|                        | - SE: bleeding, risk of failure (2C19 polymorphism)                                 | - D: 7 days                                                         |

|                        | - MoA: irreversible P2Y~12~ ADPRA                                                   | - E: urine \> bile                                                  |
|                        | - SE: bleeding, TTP                                                                 | - D: 7 days                                                         |

|                        | - Has an equipotent metabolite                                                      | - E: bile \> urine                                                  |
|                        | - SE: bleeding, dyspnoea (esp if asthma)                                            | - D: 2 days                                                         |

|                        |                                                                                     | - D: 8 hours                                                        |
